sloka: इत्युक्त्वा चाङ्कमानीय भरतम् भ्रातृवत्सलम् ।परिष्वज्य महाबाहुम् रुरोद भृशदुःखिता ॥२-७५-६३॥
transliteration: ityuktvā cāṅkamānīya bharatam bhrātṛvatsalam ।pariṣvajya mahābāhum ruroda bhṛśaduḥkhitā ॥2-75-63॥

translations.english: After having addressed Bharata, who was affectionate towards his brother that way, Kausalya drew the mightyarmed one onto her lap and hugged him and cried out with extreme grief.
